recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It corrects the remaining semantic application error by making tools bind dataType values to concept-property-type rather than incorrectly binding status values; no further core change is needed unless a future work-group decision changes CodeSystem property datatype wording or the concept-property-type value set.
issue_request: FHIR-48428 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add a dataType property to http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties, populate each defined concept property with its datatype, and constrain those values. The final Jira comments and TI follow-up use the existing http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/concept-property-type value set rather than creating a new CoreConceptPropertyDataTypes value set.
initial_application: Commit 2bc7ab59c65b2fabdf8631bc3af22d997763853a added the dataType property and populated concept dataType values, but inserted the codesystem-property-valueset extension on the following status property definition. Later commits refined date values to dateTime and added more concept properties without correcting the misplaced extension.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes concept-properties under [codesystems], so the edited CodeSystem source is in build scope. The codesystem-property-valueset extension is scoped to CodeSystem.property and is intended to identify permitted values for a coded property. FHIR-45679 is duplicate/background context about the comment property datatype, and FHIR-53549 is an unresolved Triaged text issue that does not supersede the applied FHIR-48428 decision.
reconciliation: Moved the codesystem-property-valueset extension to the dataType CodeSystem.property block and removed it from the status property block, leaving the existing concept-property-type value set and all concept dataType values unchanged.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml: moved the http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/codesystem-property-valueset extension from status to dataType.

related_jiras.note: Earlier duplicate/background report that the comment concept property should be string rather than code; current source already has dataType=string for comment.
Later Triaged issue about CodeSystem property datatype wording; unresolved and not a final decision for this binding placement.
